description: 3 pages: a shared decoration (the same PDF object) + large content, unique per page.

expected.note: Construction fact: ONE shared PDF object of a decoration (2x2px, x=10-40,y=10-40, a constant position on ALL 3 pages) + one UNIQUE content image per page (4x4px, ~0.62 of the page area, the position differing by >0.5pt between pages). Because pdf.js doesn't assign a stable objId from the first use, imageRegistry.ts will probably split the decoration into TWO entries: pageRefs=[1] (the first occurrence) and pageRefs=[2,3] (the later ones), LINKED through correlatedWith (the identical quantized bbox of the first occurrence). classifyImages() must use the CORRELATED page count (not the raw pageRefs.length) and classify BOTH decoration entries as 'decoration' — INCLUDING the one with pageRefs=[1] (the first page). The content on each page (3 different entries, each pageRefs.length=1, a different position) should stay 'content'.
